# Changelog

## 0.1.0 (2026-11-18)


### Features

* one-file install from jsDelivr, and apathy-update
* versioned releases, with $APATHY_VERSION


### Bug Fixes

* Shift+Enter and a trailing backslash add a line to a prompt
* "yes please", "read the README" and "test it" go to the agent
* Atuin records prompts instead of blank entries
